provenance.patch: ref/inputs/patches/haloce-patch-1.0.10.exe (official Custom Edition 1.10 update, Microsoft Authenticode, from Bungie's original URL via the Wayback Machine)
provenance.method: scripts/prepare-patched-client.sh then scripts/assemble-custom-original.py; no installation, no product key
provenance.decision: Chris directed on 2026-09-26 that the supplied repo copy be used to proceed with engineering.
provenance.not_established: Key-installed original-client baseline (G1b); independent third-party hash confirmation; distribution rights (G12).

keystone.role: Microsoft Keystone UI library shipped with the game: Halo loads it at start-up (unless -safemode) and draws the multiplayer chat edit box and chat log with it through its own Direct3D device

ksimeui.role: Keystone IME user interface, a static import of Keystone.dll

controls.role: Keystone control library shipped with the game (edit box, list box, label); Keystone loads it by path. Its preferred base 0x10200000 is Keystone's, so the Windows loader relocates it; HaloPad applies its relocation table once, at 0x10330000 (the first 64 KiB boundary after Keystone), and translates that image
